title: Representing the universal rank clause without canonical map conditions
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Assume that for every $g:T\to S$ the tensor-pullback/pushforward adjunction unit at $\mathcal O_T$ [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction] for $p_g:X\times_S T\to T$ is an isomorphism. Let $E$ be finite locally free [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf]. There exist a scheme $W$ and an immersion $j:W\to S$, locally of finite presentation and quasi-compact, such that for every $g:T\to S$, $g$ factors through $j$ if and only if $R(f,E,g)$ [def-sc-picard-universal-rank-match]. No canonical base-change-map invertibility is part of the representing condition.

theorem exists_picardUniversalRankMatchLocus {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (hO : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S),
      IsIso ((Classical.choose
        (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g))).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf)))
    (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree] :
    ∃ (W : Scheme.{u}) (j : W ⟶ S),
      IsImmersion j ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation j ∧ QuasiCompact j ∧
      ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S),
        (∃ h : T ⟶ W, h ≫ j = g) ↔ PicardUniversalRankMatch f E g
